g.title: Admit explicit request; Command handling (MOD-010); Validate the bounded v2/v4 task and selectors; do not infer decisions.
Preview is selected.
Inspect preview snapshot; Work record storage (MOD-011); Read a coherent snapshot and construct/validate the proposed candidate without authoring current state.
Prepare preview receipt; Command handling (MOD-010); Serialize bounded prospective effects without a saved claim.
Return preview; no reservation. Actual execution repeats freshness checks.
Acquire writer exclusion; Work record storage (MOD-011); Acquire ordinary lease, reject maintenance fence and start BEGIN IMMEDIATE.
Inspect coherent before-state; Work record storage (MOD-011); Load selected typed rows from the associated supported database.
Construct and recheck candidate; Work record storage (MOD-011); Check opaque revision and declared reads; construct complete facts, issue dispositions and support state.
Prepare bounded receipt; Command handling (MOD-010); Prepare the fixed profile result before COMMIT and enforce candidate/result bounds.
Candidate is semantically identical under fresh preconditions.
Release unchanged writer; Work record storage (MOD-011); End the transaction and return unchanged without incrementing semantic revision.

text.tspan: No duplicate facts; a stale request

g.title: No duplicate facts; a stale request remains conflict.
Publish complete candidate; Work record storage (MOD-011); Persist normalized related rows and new revision inside the transaction.
Commit durable transaction; Work record storage (MOD-011); COMMIT under the qualified WAL/FULL connection; precommit failure rolls back.
Clean up and return receipt; Work record storage (MOD-011); Release owned resources and return established outcome; failure after commit cannot imply rollback.
The complete current account is committed atomically before saved is reported; output delivery is a separate boundary.

text.tspan: See the recorded conditions and effects below

g.title:
Admission, candidate or receipt validation fails. Reject without authoritative task effects. Private temporary data is not current record authority.
Revision/read basis conflicts or storage is busy. Conflict or busy; caller rereads before deciding. Winning committed work remains authoritative.
Transaction or response is interrupted. Inspect coherent recovered state; never replay semantic task or infer success from missing output. SQLite establishes committed/uncommitted state; corrupt or unavailable state stops safely.
